outcome: Only an approved, current original requirement can supply inputs to board-bound planning and implementation.
acceptance: Unapproved WorkItems and caller-supplied confirmation cannot start board-bound planning or implementation
Approved inputs preserve source quotes, goals, actors, and acceptance across reload
Changed source, candidate, or WorkItem scope invalidates approval and blocks continuation
The explicit approval action can renew matching scope; generic status edits cannot issue approval
Delivery and HTTP planning use the same confirmation checks without fabricating inputs
outOfScope: Full repository coverage and duplication repair
assumptions: Board Host callers are trusted; Web routes authenticate approval actors
Standalone no-board deterministic exercises are not product approval
